_comment: Local localization overrides merged into the Localazy-downloaded ARBs AFTER `localazy download` and BEFORE `flutter gen-l10n`. Use this ONLY for keys that are referenced in code but missing from Localazy (e.g. the Localazy project is over its key-plan limit so new keys can't be published). Each top-level entry is a language code; each value is { key: translation }. Remove an entry once the key is properly published in Localazy.
